title: Hands-On Smart Mushroom Farming and Incubation Preparation
location: JKUAT Smart Farm Zone, Juja, Kenya
summary: A practical field activity where the BRIDGE-AI Kenya team participated in mushroom bag preparation and incubation activities while learning directly from experienced farmers.
body: The BRIDGE-AI Kenya team participated in a hands-on Smart Mushroom farming activity at a partner mushroom farm in Juja, Kenya. The session focused on the preparation of mushroom grow bags for incubation, providing participants with practical experience in substrate handling, bag filling, spawn application, hygiene, and organization of the production process. Team members worked alongside experienced farmers and actively participated in preparing and arranging the mushroom bags before transporting them to the incubation facility. The activity provided valuable insight into the practical realities of mushroom production and highlighted opportunities where artificial intelligence, IoT sensors, and digital monitoring technologies can support farmers. The field experience also strengthened collaboration between the project team and farming communities while contributing to the capacity-building objectives of the Smart Mushroom Project.
